items.rationale: Telcm returned 18.7% (z=45.62). Its residual_z is 38.38, well above the ~8 threshold, with expected_ret of only 0.30%. The peers are quiet, with a peer_median of 0.62%, which is within 2%. A move this large with no peer move is most likely a bad vendor tick, not a real market move. I treat the sleeve as unchanged for today, provisionally, for human review. There were no vendor notes, so there was nothing untrusted to disregard.
